main.description: Get private-tier posts by AT-URI. Requires auth by a ready community member. A URI that does not exist, is not authorized for the requester, or cannot be served is omitted from the response; other URIs are unaffected.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.
